text: DSH Math Notes Assistant 是面向数学笔记的 Obsidian 桌面插件和 DSH 预设。它注册长期记忆 agent、记忆管理面板，并把 vault 加入 DSH 工作区。主要功能包括跨会话记忆、笔记与记忆统一检索、创建 Markdown 笔记、查询 wikilink 反向链接，以及查看和反馈记忆卡片。适合希望在自己的知识库中继续数学学习、查找旧笔记并延续上下文的用户。需要 Obsidian、DeepSeek Harness 和已配置的 DeepSeek 模型；笔记与记忆存于本地 vault。

DSH Math Notes Assistant is an Obsidian plugin for math notes and a DeepSeek Harness preset. It adds cross-session memory, a panel to review memory, joint search across notes and memory, Markdown note creation, and backlink lookup. It requires Obsidian and a configured DeepSeek Harness model.

dsh-math-memory README · DSH Math Notes Assistant (dsh-math-memory)：[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> A math-notes assistant that lives in Obsidian's right sidebar and remembers what you were working on between sessions.

Most chat assistants forget everything when a conversation ends. This one keeps your notes and a long-term memory inside your own vault, so a new session can pick up where the last one stopped. Everything stays on your machine.

dsh-math-memory README · What it does：- **Remembers across sessions.** It keeps a profile, typed memory cards, idea memos and raw conversation evidence in `.deepseek/`, all as plain Markdown you can read and edit.
- **Finds things in one search.** `note_recall` searches your notes and all memory layers together, then reads the best hits before answering.
- **Lets you review and correct.** A memory panel shows what it knows; each card can be confirmed, marked wrong or archived, and replies link back to the cards they used.
- **Stays out of the way.** Notes stay in your vault, the service listens on localhost only, and the assistant has no shell, no web access and no delete tools.

dsh-math-memory README · Current status：Version **0.8.3**, still a prototype. The "remember, find, correct" loop works end to end. What is still missing is the harder half: helping you build mathematical understanding — knowing where you are stuck, what to practise next, and how to reuse your own techniques. That is what 1.0 means. The current state and open work are kept in [docs/README.md](docs/README.md).

dsh-math-memory README · Install：**A. From Obsidian (recommended).** Settings → Community plugins → Browse, search **DSH Math Notes Assistant**, then install and enable it. On first run the plugin finds DeepSeek Harness, sets up its configuration and vault templates, and starts the service.

**B. From the command line.**

```bash
npm install -g dsh-math-memory
dsh-math-memory install --vault "<path-to-your-vault>"
dsh --profile notes-assistant --port 3180
```

dsh-math-memory README · Install：**C. Manually.** Download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` from the [latest release](https://github.com/maple110011/dsh-obsidian-math/releases) and copy them into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/dsh-math-assistant/`.

dsh-math-memory README · Requirements：- Obsidian desktop and Node.js 22.5 or newer.
- DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`, **requires ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2**) with a configured DeepSeek model.
- Default port 3180. The regular dsh web uses 3080; the two can run at the same time.

dsh-math-memory README · Vault layout：```text
vault/
  AGENTS.md                     working agreement, loaded automatically
  .deepseek/
    memory/profile.md           who you are and how you like to work

dsh-math-memory README · After install：Open the sidebar and start a conversation. At the start of each session the assistant reads `AGENTS.md` and the memory index. To see or correct what it remembers, open the memory panel; to change what is captured automatically, use the capture-policy row in the panel or the plugin settings.

dsh-math-memory README · Project and development：Development commands:

```bash
npm test          # syntax + 478 zero-token regression checks + 69 route-level checks + 8 real-dsh handshake checks + 24 loopback-proxy checks + installer e2e (drift detection)
npm run qa        # engine probe (no API cost)
node scripts/build-obsidian.mjs   # rebuild main.js after changing shared files
```

- Version: **0.8.3**
dsh-math-memory README · Privacy：Everything runs locally: the service binds to 127.0.0.1, memory is Markdown inside your vault, and the session index never leaves the machine.
